description: Read DMARC aggregate (rua) reports and say who is sending as the domain and what fails: messages passing and failing, failures that are alignment only, quarantined and rejected counts, and each sending IP with its SPF and DKIM outcome, failing senders first. Takes the report XML, several of them, or a .gz report as base64. Duplicate reports are counted once.

gzipBase64.description: A gzipped report (.xml.gz), base64-encoded. Zip archives are not unpacked: send the XML inside.

xml.description: The report XML. To send several, call with gzipBase64 or repeat the call; a JSON array of XML strings is also accepted over HTTP.

name: analyze_dmarc_report
title: DMARC aggregate report
